name: Cupriferous-Sabkha
description: Sand owns this world, in colors from bone-white to burnt sienna, migrating with the seasons before a patient wind. Where the gusts strip it away, an ancient meteor crater emerge like the bones of the planet.

Storm season reorganizes all plans. When the pressure falls, animals go quiet, instruments drift, and the horizon turns the color of an old wound. Mats of pigment-bearing microbes stain the wet stone in bands of rust and violet.
Instruments disagree about the signal of unknown origin: mass reads one value, inertia another. Probes sent in return transmitting their own launch signals, timestamped hours early.
Opportunity here wears armor. Claims on rare flora and silicon are staked, defended, and occasionally avenged, and the nearest law is a week's burn away.
